Do you enjoy staying active and working in a logistics environment where no two days are the same?

DHL Supply Chain in Beringe is looking for a Logistics Employee – Day Shift for the Schneider Electric department. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that orders are processed accurately and delivered on time.

Your responsibilities will include order picking, packing, loading and unloading goods, checking and sorting products, processing incoming shipments, and storing goods in the correct warehouse locations.

You will be part of a dynamic and international working environment with a wide variety of tasks. DHL offers thorough onboarding, excellent growth opportunities, and regularly organizes fun extras such as staff parties, food trucks, and team events.

- Good command of the English language
- Experience in logistics
- Ability to work with computer systems and Microsoft Excel
- Flexible and motivated attitude
- Own transportation
- EPT, forklift and/or reach truck certificates are an advantage

Are you definitely not a morning person and do you only really get going later in the day? Then this is your ideal job! You don't start until 15:00, so you can sleep in, work out or study in the morning. On top of that, you earn a lot extra in the evening: from 20:00 onwards you get a 25% surcharge on top of your great gross hourly wage of € 16.04. A perfect opportunity to work full-time in logistics and make great money!

What we offer
- Gross hourly wage of € 16.04.
- 25% evening surcharge after 20:00!
- Perfect afternoon and evening shifts.
- Working in a fun and close-knit team.
- Career growth at the successful Plieger.
- Fresh meals in the company restaurant

Who you are
You are full of energy in the afternoon and evening. Physically demanding work is no problem for you, as you are in excellent health. Working with an EPT is (preferably) known to you.

- You are available full-time (15:00 - 00:00).
- You already have some logistics experience.
- You speak Dutch or English well.

What will you do
When the rest of the Netherlands slowly heads home, you start your workday fresh at Plieger. You collect orders, move goods with the EPT and ensure everything is ready for transport. Because you work in the afternoon and evening shift, the atmosphere is often slightly different: informal, with music in the background, but with a high work pace. Around midnight your shift is over and you go home highly satisfied.

Where will you work
Plieger in Zaltbommel is a leading wholesaler with an ultra-modern distribution center. We are known for our down-to-earth mentality. No unnecessary rules, just putting our shoulders to the wheel together. Because Plieger continues to grow rapidly, we love to invest in you. There are plenty of opportunities to learn new skills!

Looking for a job with a great salary, awesome colleagues, and zero boring moments? Look no further! Grab your tools, and come to work as an assembly line worker by DKG in Bergen op Zoom. And yes, you read that right: you’ll be earning a sweet €17,24 per hour (including shift allowances)! 💸

What we offer
- A nice salary of €17,24 gross per hour.
- Shift allowances. You get 15% in 2 shifts!
- Get a permanent contract quickly!
- Travel allowance starting from 5 km
- Career opportunities! Become a driver or operator!

To keep the production running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as an assembly line worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;

- You are available for at least 2 shifts;
- You are able to do physical harder work;
- You can work in Bergen op Zoom;
- You have your own transport to get to the DKG factory;

What will you do
Boom! The buzzer sounds and the line starts moving. You are ready to roll! As our new Assembly Line Worker, you are the ultimate puzzle master. Together with an awesome team, you keep the production running like clockwork.
Armed with your trusty tools, you click, screw, and assemble parts into a perfect end product. Spot a scratch or a missing screw? Sharp as a hawk, you catch it instantly. Quality is your middle name! You keep your workspace spinning and your supplies stocked. Hit a daily target? High-fives all around! With high energy and a great playlist, your day flies by before you know it. 🚀

Where will you work
When people ask you what you do for work, you can say: "I'm in the kitchen all day." 🤩 At DKG de Keukenfabriek in Bergen op Zoom you work in a modern logistics warehouse. Full of kitchen parts and materials! Together with your colleagues you make sure every order leaves on time.

You'll join a friendly team with a great work atmosphere. And the best part? There are lots of growth opportunities! Grow further to a

The largest data centers in the Netherlands are in the Eemshaven. You keep the power they rely on running.
As an Electrical Engineer Data Center you work on the critical electrical installations in the Eemshaven: UPS systems, standby generators, distribution boards and the measurement and control equipment that goes with them. You carry out preventive maintenance, inspect installations, take measurements, resolve faults and record every action, because in these buildings the documentation weighs as much as the work. You are there when the manufacturer commissions new systems, so you see up close how a site is built up. If you come from commercial and industrial buildings and UPS is new to you, you learn those systems here on the installation itself. The work asks for precision and reliability: in these buildings the power must never fail.
The essentials: Salary €3.300 to €4.100 per month · 38 hours per week · Fulltime · Based in Groningen.
In this role you earn €3.300 at entry, rising to €4.100 as an experienced engineer. Growing on to Senior can later reach €4.900, but you are applying now for the Data Center Engineer role.
What you bring
- MBO 3 or 4 Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience
- Solid experience as an electrical engineer in commercial and industrial buildings, for example offices, healthcare, industry or data centers
- Knowledge of UPS systems, distribution boards, backup power and instrumentation, extensive experience with them is a strong plus
- NEN 3140 VP and VCA, or the willingness to obtain them
- Driver's license B; Dutch and English at working level

What we offer
- Work in the largest and most secure data centers in the Netherlands
- Training and certification on UPS systems from Eaton and Schneider Electric
- NEN 3140, VCA, LOTO and ESD training
- The opportunity to obtain NEN 3840 (high voltage)
- Metal & Engineering CAO with travel allowance, overtime pay and ADV days
- A clear growth path to Senior Data Center Engineer

As an experienced orbital welder, you play a key role in developing and producing prototypes and initial production runs. You work closely with engineers to evaluate new designs, determine the correct welding method, and apply it directly in the cleanroom production area. Your craftsmanship sets the standard for the rest of the production process. Thanks to your technical insight, designs are elevated to a higher level even before they reach the production line.

This role isn’t just about welding. It’s an opportunity to work daily with the latest technologies such as welding robots, cobots, lasers, and 3D printers. You bring knowledge and experience as an orbital welder perhaps also as a TIG welder or fabrication technician and you know better than anyone how to read technical drawings and translate them into top-quality work. Your structured working style, digital skills, and eagerness to learn make a real difference in a production environment where innovation is the standard.

You’ll join a team full of expertise, but also one that gives you the space to grow. There’s plenty of attention given to your development, initiative is appreciated, and your contribution to the final product is visible, tangible, and measurable. - You have demonstrable work experience at a comparable level
- You have experience with orbital welding
- You speak fluent English or Dutch

- Accurate and able to follow basic logistics processes
